verdict.rationale: The docs mention per-OS install behavior for Linux and Windows (hardlinks into node_modules), so Bun's package manager evidently runs there, and its config lives in portable files (package.json, text-based bun.lock). A community user confirms Bun is fast on Windows but reports install crashes when switching between WSL and Windows, fixed by deleting lockfiles and node_modules. That is a rough edge, not a contradiction of a claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that macOS, Linux, and Windows are all supported, any statement that config and workflow are identical across OSes, documentation of the macOS install path, and independent corroboration of a consistent cross-OS experience.
